title: Escalation Routing Rule R-003: Diagnosis question asked
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-003 -- Diagnosis question asked
TRIGGER TYPE: Intent
CONDITION: Interpretation of clinical symptoms
ROUTE TO: Clinical Review (Extension 1012)
QUEUE: QUEUE_CLINICAL
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Diagnostic responsibility lies exclusively with licensed physician. AI cannot interpret ECG or assign diagnoses.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Can you confirm if this ECG shows STEMI?
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: What is the diagnosis for this patient?
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-003 (Diagnosis question asked) v1.0
